release_notes.headline_internal: Doom-loop retry recorder no longer writes records ADV refuses to read
highlights: Bound the retry-attempt history to the retry budget so a task accumulating blocked sub-agent reports can no longer produce state that fails the read-path schema and makes its change unreadable and unwritable
Changes already bricked by this defect self-repair on replay, because the correction lives in the reducer that rebuilds workflow state from history
Single shared retry-budget constant replaces two hardcoded literals that could drift and silently undo an operator repair
Attempt counts stay truthful after trimming: the true total is recorded rather than derived, and every operator-facing surface reports it
